snippet.title: Rotschwert - Out Now
snippet.description:
https://wingedfox.itch.io/rotschwert

Rotschwert is a fast-paced Slash 'em Up / Bullet Hell where you guide a lost Rabbit through a strange, forgotten realm.

Red Blade in hand, the Blue Rabbit begins her hazy crusade. With scarlet apparitions at her side - nothing will stand in her way.
